name: miraicms-monorepo
description: MiraiCMS monorepo: framework-agnostic core and Nuxt adapter.

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:prepare && pnpm --filter miraicms-playground-nuxt dev
scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm --filter @miraicms/core build && pnpm --filter miraicms-nuxt dev:prepare && pnpm --filter miraicms-playground-nuxt exec nuxt prepare
scripts.release: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run prepack && changelogen --release && pnpm --filter @miraicms/core publish && pnpm --filter miraicms-nuxt publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @miraicms/core test && pnpm --filter @miraicms/core build && pnpm --filter miraicms-nuxt test
